text:
sophia: Heads-up: PR #7067 (adaptive-alloc scheduler tweak) submitted. Need one more approval before merge. Canary ran on r4g-3 for ~2h — saw a modest memory bump on long-sequence workloads.

kevin: Link to the PR? also which canary cluster?

sophia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7067 
Canary target: r4g-3, canary id c-7067-2087654321.

lina: Quick local smoke I ran yesterday — reproduces a small p99 tail increase for seq=4096 on quantized models. Snippet: 
```
Benchmark: alloc-sched v2 vs v1
model: redwood-7b-q4
seq=4096 | v1 p99=1503ms | v2 p99=1546ms (+2.86%)
throughput avg: v1=420 tok/s | v2=428 tok/s (+1.9%)
mem peak: v1=8.9GB | v2=9.6GB (+7.9%)
```

jamie: Thanks — was the mem increase during warmup or steady-state?

lina: Steady-state on long sequences. Warmup numbers were similar. My hypothesis: KV cache retention tweak in the scheduler increases active memory for very long contexts.

kevin: @ops-bot can you paste the canary summary?

ops-bot: Canary run summary: duration=2h, success_rate=95%, tail_latency_p99 baseline->canary = 1.50s -> 1.57s, avg_throughput ~+2%, peak_mem baseline->canary = 9.1GB -> 9.9GB. No OOMs.

sophia: We need one perf/infrastructure approval to merge. @kevin can you take a look? If this reg persists on dedicated scale tests, I'd prefer to hold the merge.

kevin: I can review today. Quick glance: change is small but non-trivial. If our long-seq focused canary reproduces the regression at scale, we'll block and root-cause.

jamie: If we block, can we flip a runtime flag as an emergency rollback instead of reverting code? Is there a toggle?

sophia: Yes — runtime flag exists: `alloc.algo=heuristic_v2`. We can flip back to `heuristic_v1` without a code deploy.

lina: :thumbsup: I'll run a focused perf canary with skewed traffic (10% seq=4096, 90% seq=512) and post results in ~2h.

kevin: Perfect. If that reproduces, we'll open a perf RCA ticket and keep merge blocked.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started: id=c-7067-2087654321, target=r4g-3, checks=latency,mem,success_rate.

sophia: Thanks everyone. Tagging @jamie for release timeline visibility — if merge is blocked, shift to next window.

jamie: Noted. If blocked, move merge to Monday 10:00am window and update release notes.

sophia: I'll follow up with final canary summary once Lina posts the skewed run.
